title: Sam Altman and AI’s decel debate
content: On the latest episode of Equity, we discuss why Sam Altman has calling on the industry to "pace the rate of AI development."

title: Judge denies xAI’s request to block Minnesota ban on ‘nudify’ apps
content: Despite a lawsuit from xAI, a Minnesota ban on apps that allow users to “nudify” images can move forward.

title: YouTuber Hank Green says his AI usage is ‘not healthy’
content: Green offered a remarkable apology, saying that "the level of dopamine that I've been getting from interacting with LLMs ... is not healthy for me or good for the world."

title: Sam Altman is still making the case for parenting via ChatGPT
content: OpenAI's CEO seemed excited to share a "cool use case" for parents.

title: This $9 key physically locks your most addictive apps
content: This $9 NFC key requires you to physically scan it to unlock distracting apps on your phone.

title: OpenAI reportedly finds evidence that more of its agents ran amok
content: OpenAI has reportedly found evidence of additional agent misbehavior as it looks into the incident that occurred with Hugging Face.

title: India is starting to pay for apps, not just download them
content: India's app market generated a record $345 million in Q2.

title: Google nixes its Earth AI feature one day after launch, amid criticism it would spread misinformation
content: A tool that allowed anyone to generate fake AI-generated imagery and superimpose it over real Google Earth maps quickly spurred backlash.

title: Sam Altman isn’t the only one who wants to pump the brakes on AI

title: Snapchat no longer rewards fully AI-generated Spotlight content
content: Snapchat has adjusted its recommendation systems to ensure that only videos created by real people are eligible for Spotlight recommendations, taking a stance against AI slop.

title: Siri AI could come with a paywall for power users
content: Apple CEO Tim Cook envisions users being able to buy more compute for Siri AI via Apple's existing iCloud+ subscriptions.

title: SpaceX won’t remove all of xAI’s unpermitted turbines for another year
content: SpaceX is building a new power plant for xAI's Colossus data centers, but it won't remove existing, unpermitted turbines for many more months.

title: Smallest.ai raises $13M to build ultra-fast voice AI that sounds genuinely human
content: The startup is building voice models designed to make AI phone calls pass the Turing test.
